m: चिट् (derived from चेट) cl. 1. P. चेटति, to send out, Dhātup. ix, 28.
a: चिट् — {c1c} P., {c10c} U. (चेटति, चेटयति-ते) To send forth or out (as a servant.)

v: strI ciwa--ka gOrA॰ NIz । caRqAlaveSaGAriRyAM yoginyAm tanmantraprayogaH tantrasAre ukto yaTA । “tAraM ciwidvayaM brUyAccARqAli ca tataH param । mahadAdyaM tato brUyAdamukaM me tataH param । vaSamAnaya Wa--dvandvaM ciwimantra udAhftaH (oM ciwi! ciwi! mahAcARqAli amukaM me vaSamAnAya svAhA) saptaBirdivasErBUpAn vaSayedviDinA janaH” । viDi mAha । “viliKya tAlapatre taM sADyanAmnADigarBitam । niHkzipya kzIrasaMmiSre jale tatkvATayenniSi । vaSyo Bavati sADyo'sya nAtra kAryyA vicAraRA । tAlapatre liKitvEnaM BadrakAlIgfhe Kanet । vaSyAya sarvajantUnAM prayogo 'yamudAhftaH” ।

s: preze । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvAM-paraM-sakaMsew .) cewati BftyaM svAmI । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
